profile.title: Profile
profile.rating_faq_q1: What is the rating and how is it calculated?
profile.rating_faq_a1: Your rating is a score on a 5-point scale, built from the ratings brands and organizers give you. It updates after each collaboration.
profile.rating_faq_q2: What does the rating consist of?
profile.rating_faq_a2: Your rating is scored across four core skills: punctuality, power talk, happy talk, and engagement. The average of these four scores forms your overall rating.
profile.rating_faq_a3: A high rating builds brands' trust in you, gives you priority for new offers and events, and ranks your profile higher in search and recommendations. A low rating, on the other hand, can mean fewer new collaboration offers.
profile.rating_faq_q4: I think I was given an unfair rating. What can I do?
profile.rating_faq_a4: If you believe you received an incorrect or unjustified rating, contact support — we'll look into it. That said, approaching every collaboration responsibly is still the best protection.
profile.rating_faq_a5: Your rating updates automatically — once a brand or organizer leaves you a new rating, the updated score appears on your profile shortly after.
